Let's say Alexandra has superior chimestry. Alexandra call Alastor on
herself. Next round she enter combat and play illusions of the kindred
at superior. Another Alexandra enter play, combat mojo and amaranth.
Can the illusion play amaranth and diablerized. I think so, because it
is the illusion who play the amaranth not the one with the alastor.
Also, can the illusion of Alexandra untap the real one when she enter
play. Thank you.

Sagarassi

Can the illusion of Alexandra play a Psyche! at superior when combat
ends, or will she be removed from the game before she has a chance to?
If the answer is yes, does a new combat start or does she get removed
from the game?

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Tim wrote:
> Can the illusion of Alexandra play a Psyche! at superior when combat
> ends, or will she be removed from the game before she has a chance to?
> If the answer is yes, does a new combat start or does she get removed
> from the game?

The latter. The Illusion is removed when combat ends. Psyche! is
played when combat ends. By the time Psyche! could be played, the
Illusion is already gone.

http://groups.google.com/groups?q=author:LSJ+illusions+of+the+kindred+psyche!&hl=en&lr=&ie=UTF-8&scoring=d&selm=3D0735B7.8E0AE881%40white-wolf.com&rnum=10

--Colin McGuigan
